source.notes: A bank of 112 practice items (not an examination paper) published by CBSE for its competency-based education programme; each item carries its own mark scheme, which is the source of every officialAnswer. Items were written for the NCERT Class 9 Mathematics book current in 2021. Chapters were mapped by topic to the current Ganita Manjari Part I chapters and must be confirmed by an editor; items on topics not in Part I (lines and angles, triangles, quadrilaterals, surface areas and volumes, statistics, percentages) have chapter null. Item numbers are the printed item references (e.g. Maths9GB4); parts are the printed question labels. Marks are taken from the question where printed, otherwise from the item metadata. Symbol-font characters (∠, °, α, Δ) were recovered from private-use code points, and degree signs printed as a raised 0 were rebuilt as °.
